question: Which of the following states has the highest entrepreneurial activity in the infrastructure sector as per the Economic Survey 2019-20?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jharkhand.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Economic Survey 2019-20**__

 
 
• The theme of Economic Survey 2020 is “**Enable markets, promote ‘pro-business policies and strengthen ‘trust’ in the economy”.**
 
• Pro-business policies increase **competition, correct market failures, or enforce business accountability, pro-crony policies hurt markets.**
 
• The Economic Survey 2019-20 was tabled in the Parliament by Finance Minister **Nirmala Sitharaman **recognised entrepreneurship as a significant tool for wealth creation and productivity growth in the country.
 
• The data revealed that the impact of new firm entry is the greatest in the manufacturing and services sector.
 
• It strengthened the **visible hand of the market.**
 
• The taxes paid by the entrepreneurs enable Government spending on creating public goods and providing welfare benefits.
 
• Entrepreneurship acts as the engine of economic growth and change in India.
 
• Proximity to large population centres likely allows the startup to expand markets and scale operations.
